name: Frontiers
notes: Per-system skies: clear, nebula, storm lightning, ion, dust, and deep uncharted looks.
Couriers and freighters jump between systems and leave scannable hyperspace wakes.
Wake scan reveals destination and can plot a follow route; ships reappear on arrival.
Wanted tiers escalate; wiping local security scrambles a response team.
Temporary DEV menu for teleport, credits, bounty, wakes, and response testing.
